card.text: A star 34% of the Sun's width that turns once in 10.7 hours, with a mapped magnetic field.

introduction.text: Morin et al. give it 0.34 solar radii, 0.28 solar masses, a rotation period of 10.7 hours and an axis tilted 70° from the line of sight.

color.title: Photosphere color
color.summary: The color of the star's light, dimmed toward the edge by a model atmosphere.
